findings.checklist_item: Specify that the detector call is best-effort — wrap cross_session_warning_for in a swallowing guard (mirroring _maybe_warn_cross_session's `except Exception: pass`) so the advisory never converts a succeeding library call into a raise.
evidence: src/rebar/_cli/_execute.py:79 `except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — advisory warning must never break the command`
cross_session_warning_for calls load_config (src/rebar/_commands/cross_session.py:41), and ConfigError is a documented raise of the write path
Plan text describes an unguarded inline emit with no swallowing
findings.finding: The plan calls cross_session_warning_for inline with no error containment, but the CLI's equivalent (_maybe_warn_cross_session) deliberately wraps it in try/except Exception: pass because the advisory 'must never break the command'; the detector calls load_config which can raise ConfigError (per transition/claim docstrings), so an unguarded call would raise out of show_ticket/comment/etc. that previously succeeded.
findings.location: Approach — 'call cross_session_warning_for(...) and, when it returns a string, warnings.warn(...)'
scenarios: An unreadable rebar config while acting as session B: rebar.show_ticket now raises ConfigError from the advisory path instead of returning the ticket
findings.suggested_fix: State in the Approach that the emit is best-effort: `try: msg = cross_session_warning_for(ticket_id, repo_root=repo_root); ... except Exception: pass`, matching the CLI's advisory contract.

findings.checklist_item: Specify that the detector is computed against the ticket's PRE-mutation state (capture the warning before performing the write) so writes warn about the holder at the time of acting.
evidence: cross_session_warning reads state.get('claimed_session') (src/rebar/_commands/cross_session.py:24)
transition can change the ticket's claim/status (src/rebar/_lib_writes.py:351)
Plan only specifies 'before returning', not 'before mutating'
findings.finding: For write functions the plan says to warn 'before returning' but does not fix whether the detector runs before or after the mutation. cross_session_warning_for reads live claim state via show_ticket, so computing it after a mutation (notably transition/reopen, which change claim/status) can observe a changed or absent holder and warn about the wrong state (or fail to warn).
scenarios: transition that moves a ticket out of in_progress: post-mutation detector sees no holder and emits nothing, so the cross-session act goes unwarned
findings.suggested_fix: Compute cross_session_warning_for once at function entry (before the mutation), retain the message, and warnings.warn it just before returning.
